import sys
from collections import deque

class Solver:
    def __init__(self):
        self.n = 0
        self.t = 0
        self.grid = [""] * 10
        self.sci = [[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
        self.resc = [[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
        self.inf_time = [[-1]*10 for _ in range(10)]
        self.reach_time = [[[[-1]*10 for _ in range(10)] for _ in range(10)] for _ in range(10)]
        self.di = [-1, 1, 0, 0]
        self.dj = [0, 0, -1, 1]
        self.FLOW_N = 2 * 10 * 10 + 2
        self.INF = 1000000000
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(self.FLOW_N + 1)]
        self.cap = [[0]*(self.FLOW_N+1) for _ in range(self.FLOW_N+1)]
        self.flow = [[0]*(self.FLOW_N+1) for _ in range(self.FLOW_N+1)]
        self.ptr = [0]*(self.FLOW_N+1)
        self.level = [0]*(self.FLOW_N+1)
        self.parent = [0]*(self.FLOW_N+1)

    def add_edge(self, u, v, c):
        self.adj[u].append(v)
        self.adj[v].append(u)
        self.cap[u][v] += c

    def bfs_level(self, s, t):
        self.level = [-1]*(self.FLOW_N+1)
        self.level[s] = 0
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            for v in self.adj[u]:
                if self.cap[u][v] - self.flow[u][v] > 0 and self.level[v] == -1:
                    self.level[v] = self.level[u] + 1
                    q.append(v)
        return self.level[t] != -1

    def dfs_find(self, u, t):
        if u == t:
            return True
        while self.ptr[u] < len(self.adj[u]):
            v = self.adj[u][self.ptr[u]]
            if self.level[v] == self.level[u] + 1 and self.cap[u][v] - self.flow[u][v] > 0:
                if self.dfs_find(v, t):
                    self.parent[v] = u
                    return True
            self.ptr[u] += 1
        return False

    def maxFlow(self, s, t):
        ans = 0
        while self.bfs_level(s, t):
            self.ptr = [0]*(self.FLOW_N+1)
            while True:
                self.parent = [-1]*(self.FLOW_N+1)
                self.parent[s] = 0
                if not self.dfs_find(s, t):
                    break
                add = self.INF
                v = t
                while v != s:
                    u = self.parent[v]
                    add = min(add, self.cap[u][v] - self.flow[u][v])
                    v = u
                v = t
                while v != s:
                    u = self.parent[v]
                    self.flow[u][v] += add
                    self.flow[v][u] -= add
                    v = u
                ans += add
        return ans

    def node(self, i, j, right):
        return i * self.n + j + (self.n * self.n if right else 0)

    def solve(self):
        data = sys.stdin.read().split()
        it = iter(data)
        self.n = int(next(it))
        self.t = int(next(it))
        bomb = (0, 0)
        for i in range(self.n):
            line = next(it)
            self.grid[i] = line
            for j, ch in enumerate(line):
                if ch == 'Y':
                    pass  # grid already has 'Y'
                elif ch == 'Z':
                    bomb = (i, j)
                else:
                    self.sci[i][j] += int(ch)
        for i in range(self.n):
            line = next(it)
            for j, ch in enumerate(line):
                if ch != 'Y' and ch != 'Z':
                    self.resc[i][j] += int(ch)

        # BFS for infection times
        self.inf_time = [[-1]*self.n for _ in range(self.n)]
        self.inf_time[bomb[0]][bomb[1]] = 0
        q = deque()
        q.append(bomb)
        while q:
            i, j = q.popleft()
            for d in range(4):
                ni = i + self.di[d]
                nj = j + self.dj[d]
                if 0 <= ni < self.n and 0 <= nj < self.n and self.grid[ni][nj] == '.' and self.inf_time[ni][nj] == -1:
                    self.inf_time[ni][nj] = self.inf_time[i][j] + 1
                    q.append((ni, nj))

        # BFS for reach times from each empty cell
        self.reach_time = [[[[-1]*self.n for _ in range(self.n)] for _ in range(self.n)] for _ in range(self.n)]
        for i in range(self.n):
            for j in range(self.n):
                if self.grid[i][j] != '.':
                    continue
                self.reach_time[i][j][i][j] = 0
                q = deque()
                q.append((i, j))
                while q:
                    ii, jj = q.popleft()
                    if self.inf_time[ii][jj] == -1 or self.reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] < self.inf_time[ii][jj]:
                        for d in range(4):
                            ni = ii + self.di[d]
                            nj = jj + self.dj[d]
                            if 0 <= ni < self.n and 0 <= nj < self.n and self.grid[ni][nj] == '.':
                                if (self.inf_time[ni][nj] == -1 or self.reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1 <= self.inf_time[ni][nj]) and self.reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] == -1:
                                    self.reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] = self.reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1
                                    q.append((ni, nj))

        # Build flow network
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(self.FLOW_N + 1)]
        self.cap = [[0]*(self.FLOW_N+1) for _ in range(self.FLOW_N+1)]
        self.flow = [[0]*(self.FLOW_N+1) for _ in range(self.FLOW_N+1)]

        src = 2 * self.n * self.n
        sink = src + 1
        for i in range(self.n):
            for j in range(self.n):
                if self.sci[i][j]:
                    self.add_edge(src, self.node(i, j, False), self.sci[i][j])
                if self.resc[i][j]:
                    self.add_edge(self.node(i, j, True), sink, self.resc[i][j])
                for ii in range(self.n):
                    for jj in range(self.n):
                        if 0 <= self.reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] <= self.t:
                            self.add_edge(self.node(i, j, False), self.node(ii, jj, True), self.INF)

        print(self.maxFlow(src, sink))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solver = Solver()
    solver.solve()
